summary: Iteration 22 - Testing Delete Features and Hardware Table Layout. All 2 requested features verified: 1) Delete functionality enabled throughout system (quote deletion, concept deletion in wizard), 2) Hardware page redesigned from cards to table layout.

delete_quote_endpoint.description: DELETE /api/quotes/{quote_id} endpoint exists and only allows deleting quotes in 'Borrador' status. Returns 400 for non-Borrador quotes.

delete_quote_menu_option.description: 'Eliminar Cotización' option visible in dropdown menu with red styling (text-red-600) and trash icon

delete_quote_disabled_non_borrador.description: Delete option is correctly disabled for quotes not in 'Borrador' status

wizard_setup_delete_buttons.description: Setup items in wizard have trash/delete buttons (Trash2 icon, red styling) with onClick={removeSetupItem}

wizard_recurring_basic_delete_buttons.description: Recurrentes Básicos items have delete buttons with onClick={removeRecurringBasicItem}

wizard_recurring_other_delete_buttons.description: Otros Recurrentes items have delete buttons with onClick={removeRecurringOtherItem}

wizard_delete_confirmation.description: All delete functions include window.confirm() confirmation dialog and toast success message

hardware_table_layout.description: Hardware page now displays as TABLE instead of cards with columns: Dispositivo/Accesorio, Tipo, Precio Efectivo, Precio Bs/USD, Acciones

hardware_type_badges.description: Hardware types shown as colored badges (Pinpad=blue, POS=green, Cable=yellow, Base=purple, Accesorio=slate)

hardware_edit_delete_buttons.description: Edit (Pencil) and Delete (Trash2) buttons work correctly in hardware table actions column

hardware_summary_by_type.description: Summary section at bottom shows count by type: Pinpad(14), POS(3), Cable(0), Base(1), Accesorio(1)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend DELETE /api/quotes/{quote_id} correctly validates quote_status == 'Borrador' before deletion (line 1668-1674)
Frontend handleDeleteQuote function includes confirmation dialog and proper error handling (line 1156-1170)
removeSetupItem, removeRecurringBasicItem, removeRecurringOtherItem functions all include confirmation dialogs and toast feedback
Hardware.jsx table implementation follows MediosPago style with proper columns and summary section
All delete buttons have consistent red styling: text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50
seed_data_creation: Created test quotes for deletion verification during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All delete features working: 1) DELETE /api/quotes/{id} only allows Borrador quotes, 2) Dropdown menu shows 'Eliminar Cotización' with red styling disabled for non-Borrador, 3) Wizard has trash buttons on all item rows (Setup, Recurrentes Básicos, Otros Recurrentes) with confirmation dialogs. Hardware page now uses table layout with type badges and summary section.
